source.publication: 2025 Form MO-1040, Form MO-A and Form MO-1040 Instructions (Missouri Department of Revenue); 2025 Missouri Income Tax Reference Guide (Form 4711)
source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Instructions PDF p7 Line 7 income percentages and combined return; PDF p21 'A separate tax must be computed for you and your spouse'; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction

worked: Married filing combined (joint federal), ages 60 and 58. The joint limit is 32,000. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 30,000.00 + pensions 5,000.00 = 35,000.00. Federal taxable income = 35,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 3,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 35,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 35,000.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 35,000.00 - 0.00 = 35,000.00. Section B: Line 1 35,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 35,000.00; Line 4 32,000.00; Line 5 3,000.00; Line 6Y 5,000.00, Line 7Y 5,000.00; Line 8 5,000.00; Line 9 2,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 2,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 31,500.00. Line 26 subtotal 35,000.00 - 2,000.00 - 31,500.00 = 1,500.00. Line 29 taxable income 1,500.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 187.00 = 3.74; total 3.74 = 3.74. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 4; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 35,000.00 - Line 8 2,000.00 = 33,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 35,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
